name: ArithmeticFunction
LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq_deriv_riemannZeta_div
result.signature: {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : L (↗Λ) s = -deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s
result.type: ∀ {s : ℂ}, 1 < s.re → LSeries (fun n => ↑(ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n)) s = -deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s
result.value:
:=
  by
  suffices deriv (L 1) s = deriv riemannZeta s by rw [LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq hs, ← LSeries_one_eq_riemannZeta hs, this]
  refine Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq <| Filter.eventuallyEq_iff_exists_mem.mpr ?_
  exact ⟨{z | 1 < z.re}, (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_re).mem_nhds hs, fun _ ↦ LSeries_one_eq_riemannZeta⟩
result.informal_name: The von Mangoldt L-series equals the negative logarithmic derivative of the Riemann zeta function
result.informal_description: For complex numbers $ s $ with $ \operatorname{Re}(s) > 1 $, the Dirichlet series $ \sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{\Lambda(n)}{n^s} $ of the von Mangoldt function $ \Lambda $ equals $ -\frac{\zeta'(s)}{\zeta(s)} $, where $ \zeta $ denotes the Riemann zeta function and $ \zeta' $ its complex derivative.

name: riemannZeta
result.informal_description: The Riemann zeta function $\zeta(s)$ is defined as the special case of the Hurwitz zeta function (even case) evaluated at $a = 0$, given by $\zeta(s) = \frac{\Lambda(s/2)}{2\Gamma_{\mathbb{R}}(s)}$ where $\Gamma_{\mathbb{R}}(s) = \pi^{-s/2}\Gamma(s/2)$. At $s = 0$, it takes the value $-\frac{1}{2}$.

name: completedRiemannZeta
result.informal_description: For a complex number $ s $, this function is defined as $ \frac{1}{2} \Lambda\left(\frac{s}{2}\right) $, where $ \Lambda $ is the Lambda function associated with the even functional equation pair constructed from the point $ 0 $ in the unit additive circle $ \mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z} $. The result is a complex number obtained by scaling the Lambda function evaluated at half the complex argument.

name: LSeries_deriv_eqOn
result.signature: {f : ℕ → ℂ} : {s | abscissaOfAbsConv f < s.re}.EqOn (deriv (LSeries f)) (-LSeries (logMul f))
result.type: ∀ {f : ℕ → ℂ}, Set.EqOn (deriv (LSeries f)) (-LSeries (LSeries.logMul f)) {s | LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv f < ↑s.re}
result.informal_name: Derivative of $L(f, s)$ Equals $-L(\log \cdot f, s)$ on Half-Plane of Absolute Convergence
result.informal_description: For any arithmetic function $ f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C} $, the derivative of the L-series $ L(f, s) $ satisfies $ L'(f, s) = -L(g, s) $, where $ g(n) = \log n \cdot f(n) $, for all complex numbers $ s $ with $ \operatorname{Re}(s) > \sigma_a(f) $, where $ \sigma_a(f) $ denotes the abscissa of absolute convergence of $ f $.

name: riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re
result.informal_name: Non-vanishing of the Riemann Zeta Function for Real Part Greater Than One
result.informal_description: For any complex number $ s $ with $ \operatorname{Re}(s) > 1 $, the Riemann zeta function $ \zeta(s) $ is not zero.
